meta.title: Vietnam Travel Guide | Flights, Visa, Budget & Best Itinerary
meta.description:
Planning a Vietnam trip from India? ✈️
This is the ONLY Vietnam travel guide you need — especially if you’re travelling for the first time.

In this video, I break down Vietnam trip planning step-by-step — from flights, visa process, budget, hotels, local transport, food, SIM cards, apps, to perfect itineraries for 6, 10 & 13 days.

🔍 What This Vietnam Travel Guide Covers (In Detail):

✅ Best flight routes from India to Vietnam
✅ How to apply for Vietnam E-Visa (Step-by-Step) : https://thithucdientu.gov.vn/
✅ Vietnam trip budget for Indians (realistic cost)
✅ Currency exchange & daily expenses
✅ Local SIM cards & internet
✅ Best areas to stay (Hanoi, Da Nang, Ho Chi Minh)
✅ Local transport (Grab, scooters, flights, trains)
✅ Must-try Vietnamese food (veg & non-veg options)
✅ Tourist mistakes & scams to avoid
✅ 6-day, 10-day & 13-day Vietnam itineraries

Hanoi • Ninh Binh • Ha Long Bay • Da Nang • Hoi An • Ho Chi Minh City • Cu Chi Tunnels • Phu Quoc

💰 Vietnam Trip Cost From India (Approx):

🔹 Budget Trip: ₹65,000 – ₹75,000 per person
🔹 Comfortable Trip: ₹75,000 – ₹1,10,000 per person
🔹 Luxury Trip: ₹1.3 – ₹1.5 lakh+

(Flights, hotels, transport, food & experiences included)

Hey! 😊
For accommodation, look at Old Quarter (Hanoi), My Khe Beach (Da Nang), Duong Dong Street (Phu Quoc), and District 1 (Ho Chi Minh City) — these are prime areas with easy access to major attractions.

For day trips, we usually curate an all-inclusive package covering stays, sightseeing, transfers, and visa assistance, so everything stays seamless.

Hope this helps ✨
